description:
Bolivar Belicosos Finos Cabinet Box – Buy Bolivar Belicosos Finos Cabinet Box

DESCRIPTION

Box of 25, 5 1/2 x 52

To begin with, This cigar is likely to be one of the most interesting in its own format. The delightful smoking process, starting with the scent of wild herbs and shrubs, is rapidly developing into a complex and subtle blend of flavors of wood and spice notes. Complements the seductive picture of the perfect-fitting wrapper color of dark chocolate.

This deluxe cigar emits earth and leather tones. It is very well-balanced and best when aged. It has a medium to full body accompanied by pleasant aromas and subtle flavors. Rated 92 & ranked #1 by Cigar Aficionado.

Bolivar Belicosos Finos Cabinet Box for sale 

Secondly, If you’re going to have 10 Cuban cigars in your humidor, and if you like some variety in your vitolas (shapes), then you are going to want the Bolívar Belicoso Fino in that collection. The Bolívar Belicoso Fino is, in my opinion, one of the most elegant Cuban cigars you can smoke.

Flavor

Thirdly The Bolívar Belicoso Fino, 5.5 x 52, is among the most full-bodied of Cuban cigars. That, of course, is relative to the traditionally medium body of most Cuban cigars, but the Bolívar Belicoso Fino is definitely full of flavor. I’d call it medium-full in power. Until recently, this was the only Figurado in the Bolívar brand. (A Salomón, 7.25 x 57, called Armonías, was released in 2008 as a Regional Edition for China.)

 Buy Cuban Cigars

The Bolívar Belicoso Fino has delivered a complex mix of mineral notes, slightly bitter cocoa, and coffee beans. The power is there in the form of an earthiness contained in a good amount of smoke. This, to my experience, is one of the most consistent and best-drawing cigars made in Cuba. In 2018, the Bolívar Belicoso Fino was a Cigar Aficionado top 25 cigar of the year.
